05 / A little reassurance

Before
we begin.

It’s okay to be curious. It’s okay to be unsure. Here are a few things you might be wondering.

Ask Taylor a question ↗
Do I need questions ready?

No. Bring specific questions if you have them. If not, tell me what you're going through and the session takes shape from there.

What can I ask about?

Love, relationships, marriage, family, work, direction, life changes, energy, personal growth and spiritual concerns.

Which service should I book?

For specific questions or a general conversation, book a spiritual consultation. For card-based guidance, tarot. An aura interpretation looks at your energy. Chakra and sound sessions are for relaxing, reflecting and resetting.

Is it confidential?

Yes. Every session is private and confidential.

How long does a reading take?

Spiritual consultations are 30, 60 or 90 minutes. Tarot runs about 15 to 45 minutes. Other services vary.

What should I bring?

Nothing. A journal or notes is fine if you want to remember what we talk about.

Can I book for someone else?

Yes, as long as they know about the appointment and agree to it.

Can I combine services?

Often, yes, depending on availability and time booked. Call or text to set up a combined session.

What if I get emotional?

It happens. Take your time. You can pause or change the subject at any point.

Are you really available 24 hours?

Yes. Call or text 508-493-0526 any time to check availability.
